inputs.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Location 1> is the empty place in the first frame: a sunlit stone courtyard: an open arcade of pale stone columns and arches along a pale plaster wall, a black iron railing on a low plinth in front of the arcade, olive trees in terracotta pots, worn stone paving.

summary:
[keyframe completion] 5 locked-off views of the same empty location, separated by hard cuts, for an environment reference sheet.

retention_analysis:
<Location 1> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - The same walls, furniture, barrier, floor and light in every view. Only the camera position and direction change.

detailed_description:
The location is completely empty: no people and no animals, and nothing within it moves. Every shot is a locked-off static camera at eye level, the horizon level and centred, no camera movement of any kind, except the last, which looks straight down.
[Shot 1] The first frame's view: from the open paving, looking at the black iron railing on its low plinth and the open arcade of pale stone columns and arches behind it, an olive tree in a terracotta pot.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.000, hard cut: from the open paving further along the railing, looking back along it: the railing, its plinth and the arcade with its columns and arches run along the right side of the frame, the open sunlit paving along the left side.
[Shot 3] At 00:02.000, hard cut: from the shade under the arcade, close behind the railing, looking straight out across the open courtyard at its far side.
[Shot 4] At 00:03.000, hard cut: from the other end of the railing looking along it the other way: the railing and the arcade on the left, the open paving on the right.
[Shot 5] At 00:04.000, hard cut to a straight-down view of the whole courtyard, like an architect's cutaway: the arcade along the top edge, the railing in front of it, the open paving below. Hold to the end. Each cut changes the camera instantly; the architecture stays fixed.
